blocks.html: The options for the S3 file provider module.

types.name: file_url
types.description: The base URL used to construct public file URLs.

types.name: access_key_id
types.description: The AWS access key ID used for authentication.

types.name: secret_access_key
types.description: The AWS secret access key used for authentication.

types.name: session_token
types.description: The AWS session token used for temporary credentials.

types.name: authentication_method
types.description: The authentication method to use when connecting to S3.

types.name: region
types.description: The AWS region where the S3 bucket is located.

types.name: bucket
types.description: The name of the S3 bucket to upload files to.

types.name: prefix
types.description: An optional prefix (folder path) to prepend to uploaded file keys.

types.name: endpoint
types.description: A custom endpoint URL, used for S3-compatible storage services.

types.name: cache_control
types.description: The value of the `Cache-Control` header set on uploaded objects.

types.name: download_file_duration
types.description: The duration in seconds for which a download URL remains valid.

types.name: additional_client_config
types.description: Additional configuration options passed directly to the S3 client.

types.name: acl
types.description:
Controls the ACL set on uploaded objects.

- `undefined` (default): Uses "public-read" for public files and "private" for private files.
- `false`: Omits the ACL header entirely. Required for S3 buckets with
  BucketOwnerEnforced Object Ownership or Block Public Access enabled.
- A specific `ObjectCannedACL` value: Uses that ACL for all uploads.
